dataNotice.label: Data Stored in Switzerland
dataNotice.text: All restaurant and guest data is stored exclusively on servers located in Switzerland, fully compliant with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (revDSG / nFADP) and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Your data never leaves Swiss jurisdiction.

about.heroSubtitle: miMesa was built to help restaurateurs focus on what they do best: creating unforgettable experiences for their guests.
about.story1: It started with a simple observation: managing reservations was becoming a chore, not a hospitality tool. Clunky interfaces, expensive per-cover fees, and disconnected systems were holding restaurants back.
about.story2: We gathered a team of designers, engineers, and hospitality veterans to build something different. A system that looks as good as your dining room and works as hard as your head chef.
about.story3: Today, miMesa serves thousands of guests daily, helping restaurants reclaim their time and ownership of their customer relationships.
about.value1Desc: We build software with the same care you serve your guests. Every pixel is considered, every interaction smoothed out.
about.value2Desc: No hidden fees, no per-cover taxes. We are partners in your success, not a tax on your growth.
about.value3Desc: Tools shouldn't just work; they should inspire. A beautiful interface reduces stress and increases joy.

featuresPage.heroSubtitle: Powerful tools for reservations, table management, and guest relationships.
featuresPage.card1Desc: Drag and drop reservations onto your exact floor plan. See availability at a glance and maximize seating capacity.
featuresPage.card2Desc: Accept reservations 24/7 from your website, Google, and social media. No cover fees, ever.
featuresPage.card3Desc: Build a database of your guests. Track allergies, preferences, and visit history to provide personalized service.
featuresPage.card4Desc: Quote accurate wait times and notify guests via SMS when their table is ready.
featuresPage.card5Desc: Plan server rotations and manage floor sections effortlessly.
featuresPage.card6Desc: Understand your peak times, most loyal guests, and revenue trends with detailed reports.
featuresPage.speedDesc: In a busy restaurant, every second counts. miMesa is built to be fast, responsive, and easy to learn.
